mentions.name: Rigove
mentions.description: This website lets users swap "rightmove" for "rigove" in a Rightmove property URL to get a page showing where else that property for sale is listed, reducing reliance on Rightmove's dominance of UK house-hunting traffic. Coverage is still limited, with plans to reach out to estate agents to increase it.
mentions.problem: The UK real estate market is broken, with Rightmove dominant and controlling much of the traffic for house hunting.
mentions.audience: House hunters browsing properties for sale in the UK
mentions.source_excerpt:
As a small way of standing up to them I created https://rigove.co.uk/ (rightmove without htm - the hidden toll machine ;)

If you change rightmove to rigove while browsing a property for sale you get a page which shows where else that property is listed.
mentions.author: africajam
